hypotheses.statement: Relative to Hadamard, learned rotations may accumulate larger FP-relative recurrent drift and downstream output perturbation on learned-regression units even when their one-step local QDQ error is not larger.
existing_support: Learned-vs-H endpoint results contain more regressions than rescues
Historical FP/Native/H replay links late state-error summaries to failure, but does not include C5/C6
counterevidence: No C5/C6 recurrent state or logits existed before this task
Matrix distance from Hadamard has no causal interpretation
hypotheses.decision_change: If supported, prioritize an inference-aligned persistent stability constraint rather than minimizing one-step state reconstruction alone.

hypotheses.statement: The learned deficit may be chiefly a downstream decision/trajectory-stability mismatch rather than a uniformly worse local quantization error.
existing_support: Regression outputs are descriptively longer and more post-commit/repetitive/retractive; rescue outputs show the opposite direction
C6 improves over C5 by only 3/60 with substantial paired churn
counterevidence: Behavior associations are descriptive and endpoint-selected
No causal intervention has been run
hypotheses.decision_change: If persistent function/logit metrics separate regression from rescue better than local QDQ error, move the development objective downstream.

hypotheses.statement: Checkpoint selection may be misaligned because C5 and C6 use different validation-primary objectives and the retained host lacks a shared cross-objective table.
existing_support: C5 and C6 were selected at different exposures under different primary metrics
counterevidence: The final H64 logs are unavailable locally, so overfitting or validation degradation is not established
hypotheses.decision_change: Future training must select on one frozen, inference-aligned development matrix; no claim about overfitting is made here.

selection.algorithm: Use seed1 only; take deterministic lexicographic representatives of distinct formal FP/H/C5/C6 endpoint patterns, prioritizing C5/H and C6/H regressions and rescues, plus all-correct and all-wrong anchors; no internal diagnostic metric or trajectory length is used.
selection.selection_bias: Targeted endpoint-stratified panel; not an estimator of Full60 prevalence or accuracy.

sparse_protocol.token_source: existing canonical FP generated_token_ids; no sampling or free generation
sparse_protocol.qdq_timing: canonical outer C128 QDQ/writeback after each recurrent decode output; its new state affects the following step
sparse_protocol.common_physical_state: FP native; H recovered by H128; C5/C6 recovered by Delta then H128 on key axis
sparse_protocol.model_output_metrics: full-vocabulary KL(P_FP||P_condition) at temperature 1, fixed existing-FP-next-token delta NLL, fixed FP-top1 margin degradation, top1 agreement
sparse_protocol.layer_output_site: complete linear_attn.out_proj output at the current decode call; cumulative upstream differences are included
stop_rules: Any identity, nonfinite, canonical-path, cache, or measurement failure stops the dependent GPU phase without semantic retry
Projected or actual sparse GPU use above 8 GPU-hours stops expansion
No sample substitution after viewing internal metrics
No late-history claim beyond 2048 recurrent updates

intervention.rule: At most one intervention, only if sparse results identify a directional and decision-changing candidate before inspecting intervention outcomes.
